title: Canonical affine supported-section triangle and its localization models
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $K=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$ be an ideal, allowing $r=0$, and let $L\in D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $Z=V(K)=\{\mathfrak p:K\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$ and $W=X\setminus Z$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For an $A$-module $N$, let $\Gamma_K(N)=\{x:K^n x=0\text{ for some }n\geq0\}$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], and let $R\Gamma_K$ be its right derived functor. For a complex representing $L$, let $\widetilde L$ denote its termwise associated complex of quasi-coherent sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Write $R\Gamma(W,-)$ for derived Zariski module sections [pqf-def-cohomology], and $R\Gamma_Z(X,-)$ for derived sections with support in $Z$ (the right derived functor of the kernel of restriction from $X$ to $W$). Let $T_f$ be the alternating complex with $T_f^p=\prod_{i_0<\cdots<i_p}A_{f_{i_0}\cdots f_{i_p}}$ for $0\leq p<r$, zero otherwise, and differential the signed sum $\sum_{a=0}^{p+1}(-1)^a\operatorname{res}_a$. Here $A_g$ is localization at the powers of $g$. Let $E_f=[A\longrightarrow T_f^0\longrightarrow T_f^1\longrightarrow\cdots]$ with $A$ in degree zero and the diagonal augmentation. Derived tensors use a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex]. There are canonical isomorphisms
$$R\Gamma_K(L)\cong R\Gamma_Z(X,\widetilde L)\cong E_f\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}L,\qquad R\Gamma(W,\widetilde L|_W)\cong T_f\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}L.$$
They identify the augmented localization complexes with the distinguished triangle
$$R\Gamma_K(L)\longrightarrow L\longrightarrow R\Gamma(W,\widetilde L|_W)\longrightarrow R\Gamma_K(L)[1],$$
whose middle arrow is restriction. These are the derived-functor comparisons induced by the augmentations, natural in $L$, rather than unspecified isomorphisms. For ideals $K_1,K_2$ with $V(K_1)\subseteq V(K_2)$, the natural support inclusion, $\mathrm{id}_L$, and restriction from $X\setminus V(K_1)$ to $X\setminus V(K_2)$ form a morphism of these triangles. These maps respect composition; when the closed sets agree, the supported-section comparison is the identity under the displayed geometric identification. For $r=0$, $T_f=0$ and $E_f=A[0]$.

source.place: Tag 0A6T (lemma-local-cohomology-is-local-cohomology), statement and proof with the augmented and unaugmented alternating complexes; dualizing.tex Tag 0955 (lemma-local-cohomology-noetherian)(3) identifies right derived ideal torsion with closed support, and Tag 0956 (lemma-compute-local-cohomology-noetherian) gives the augmented localization model. Naturality in supports is the natural kernel-of-restriction construction of the localization triangle.

Specific input: The formal-sections comparison used before the idempotent argument in the complete-local connectedness input; no connectedness conclusion is placed in this helper.
